input.free_text_description: This system is a general application platform that serves User roles. The platform provides capabilities for person. Data is persisted through a structured data access layer.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to interact with person functionality, so that I can accomplish my person-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use person capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a User, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a User, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
